segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין בֵּין סְפָרִים לִתְפִלִּין וּמְזוּזוֹת, אֶלָּא שֶׁהַסְּפָרִים נִכְתָּבִין בְּכׇל לָשׁוֹן, וּתְפִלִּין וּמְזוּזוֹת אֵינָן נִכְתָּבוֹת אֶלָּא אַשּׁוּרִית.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The difference between» Torah «scrolls, and phylacteries and mezuzot,» in terms of the manner in which they are written, «is only that» Torah «scrolls are written in any language, whereas phylacteries and mezuzot are written only in Ashurit,» i.e., in Hebrew and using the Hebrew script.

segments.he: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: אַף בִּסְפָרִים לֹא הִתִּירוּ שֶׁיִּכָּתְבוּ אֶלָּא יְווֹנִית.
segments.en: «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Even with regard to» Torah «scrolls,» the Sages «permitted them to be written only» in «Greek.» Torah scrolls written in any other language do not have the sanctity of a Torah scroll.
